post.description: Retrieves a Cash App Pay customer grant by the ID of the customer that approved it and its own ID.
Revokes a Cash App Pay customer grant by the ID of the customer that approved it and its own ID.

**When is this event triggered?**

This event is triggered when a Cash App Pay grant status has been updated.

type.description: The type of event that occurred. `grant.status.updated` for this event.

eventId.description: A unique identifier provided by Cash App for the event.

timestamp.description: When the webhook event was created

customerId.description: ID of the customer that approved the customer grant.

grantId.description: ID of the customer grant to retrieve.

CashGrantType.description: CASHAPP for all Cash App Pay transactions
CashGrantType.title: CashGrantType

CashGrantDetailsStatus.description:
Describes whether or not this grant can be used to perform the action associated with it.

If `ACTIVE`, it can be used to perform the action.

If `EXPIRED`, it may no longer be used to perform the action due to the current time being past the "expires_at" time.

If `CONSUMED`, it was already redeemed to perform the action and cannot be used again.

If `REVOKED`, the customer or merchant explicitly unauthorized the grant, preventing it from being used to perform the action.
CashGrantDetailsStatus.title: CashGrantDetailsStatus

cashtag.description: A publicly-accessible, unique identifier (username) for individuals and businesses using Cash App.

status.description:
Describes whether or not this grant can be used to perform the action associated with it.

If `ACTIVE`, it can be used to perform the action.

If `EXPIRED`, it may no longer be used to perform the action due to the current time being past the "expires_at" time.

If `CONSUMED`, it was already redeemed to perform the action and cannot be used again.

If `REVOKED`, the customer or merchant explicitly unauthorized the grant, preventing it from being used to perform the action.

createdAt.description: When this grant was created, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format (UTC).

updatedAt.description: When this grant was last updated, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format (UTC).

expiresAt.description:
If present, indicates when the grant's status will become EXPIRED, preventing a client from using it to create payments or refunds.

The timestamp is in the [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format (UTC).
